items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: Bennett? Bennett, yeah. The red? Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. That's one of the numbers.

ctx.x: Tillman was playing saxton. Alright, I don't even know what I'm doing.

Saxton. What kind of a band was that? Did they play by head or music? Music and by head both. What kind of marches? Marches? Well, most of them got marches from what we call the banner band books. I'll get the name of the books. Bennett? Bennett, yeah. The red? Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. That's one of the numbers. But all they were listening, they had one or two of those little books, you know? Yeah. I think they're four in all. Yeah, yeah. I believe I have four of them around here. I still have them here somewhere.…
They march. What kind of jazz would you play in the street?
